messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: github_install without latex?
parts:
I'm trying to `install_github("lme4","lme4")` on MacOS (10.6) with pdfTeX installed (TexLive 2011).  I get

Running 'texi2dvi' on 'PLSvGLS.tex' failed.
Calls: <Anonymous> -> texi2pdf -> texi2dvi

I'm happy to poke around installing different TeX versions (e.g. http://joey711.github.io/phyloseq/install suggests installing MacTeX), but I'm curious more generally if there's a way to tell R to skip trying to build vignettes when installing, for users who don't have/don't want to install TeX ...

Looked around but didn't find anything.

  sincerely
    Ben Bolker

messages.author: deea3c30b4c8409f
messages.subject: Re: github_install without latex?
parts:
I would try install_github(..., build_vignettes=FALSE), see ?install_github and ?install.

Gabor
